name: bitbook-desktop
description: Barebones desktop client for the BitBook distributed social network.

scripts.build: node --check social-main.js && node --check social/core.js && node --check social/app.js && node --check scripts/security-policy.js && node --check scripts/validate-sbom.js && node --check wallet-contract/canonical.js && node --check wallet-contract/framing.js && node --check wallet-contract/model.js && node --check wallet-contract/state-machine.js && node --check wallet-contract/fakes.js && node --check wallet-contract/index.js && bash -n scripts/build-deb.sh && bash -n scripts/build-macos.sh
scripts.test: npm run test:social && npm run test:security && npm run test:wallet

author: BitBook contributors
